source_facts.claim: 20 statements with a1–5 grid, capacities2/4/8/4/2. PCA and varimax, R4.4.0 and qmethod. Overall327 sorts analysed first, then seven stakeholder groups separately.

Author factor retention combined statistical criteria and expert judgment. The prototype fixes2 factors for teaching although its third eigenvalue is1.2677>1. Its2-factor result is not attributed to the Kaiser criterion.

source_facts.kind: article rule with package numerical detail
source_facts.claim: abs(loading)>1.96/sqrt(number of statements), AND own squared loading>sum of other retained squared loadings. Both inequalities strict. Strong negative loadings may be flagged and need interpretation. Current official implementation and CRAN1.8.4 agree with p<.05; no verified p<.01-default conflict exists.

qmethod input is statements in rows and Q-sorts/persons in columns. The person-correlation matrix is therefore10×10 here; the statement score matrix is20×2. The conceptual phrase person×statement must not lead to blindly transposing the tool input.

source_facts.kind: package implementation, author-run details not confirmed
source_facts.claim: Set unflagged weights0; signed w=l/(1-l²). Weighted statement totals are standardized across statements using sample SD. Raw grid scores enter the weighted sum. Prototype rejects near-unit defining loadings within1e-12 as an explicit numerical safety policy.

Ascending z ranks map to the sorted grid; this is not round(z). Exact ties receive mean ranks and R indexing truncates fractional indices. A tie straddling grid positions can change nominal slot occupancy. Current synthetic arrays retain the intended counts without forcing a tie-break.

source_facts.kind: package assumption, not empirical author result
source_facts.claim: Assumed individual reliability0.8. Composite R=mr/[1+(m-1)r], SE=SD(z)sqrt(1-R), SED=sqrt(SEf²+SEg²). This is not an estimated Cronbach alpha or field-measured reliability.

The prototype implements two-factor comparisons at p<.05 (1.960×SED) and p<.01 (2.576×SED), strict inequalities. It does not implement all multifactor qdc categories or add multiple-comparison correction. Consensus means no difference detected under this procedure, not unanimity, equivalence or high importance.
Provisional descriptions summarize the invented arrays only. No interview reasons exist for these invented people. Do not infer motivation, population proportions, adoption or optimization weights.

source_facts.kind: article supplement fact with independent arithmetic verification
source_facts.evidence: SI pp3–5; TableS3 p14; main Table2 p4 and Table5 p8
source_facts.claim: Within a perspective w=f/(1−f²), W=10w/max(w); Total_b sums respondent-specific importance scores times W. Mean and SD are across statement totals. Category means scale to attainable grid bounds; priority is strictly >50. Exact7-card bounds13/7 and29/7 are derived from the published grid and reproduce all72 TableS3 values to printed precision. Raw327-sort replication, author SD denominator and tie conventions remain unverified.

reference_environment.scope: Two synthetic scenarios; numerical agreement is not reproduction of Cheng author data or author settings.

tolerances.discrete_outputs: exact equality: scores, flags, ranks, factor arrays, counts and distinguishing/consensus classes

reference_environment.tolerance_rationale: Matching eps and normalization removes default-iteration differences. Tight matrix/eigen tolerances allow floating-point library variation; arithmetic tolerances allow small rotation error amplified by l/(1-l^2). Never expand tolerances after a failed run. The native default eps=1e-5 result is a separately labelled diagnostic, not an alternate passing gate.
reference_environment.source_observation: The inspected psych 2.5.6 archive forwards ... to stats::varimax, allowing normalize and eps. Do not infer this from moving master. qmethod::qzscores returns loa, flagged, zsc, zsc_n and f_char; qdc is a separate official step when using qzscores.
reference_environment.dependencies: R base/recommended packages are supplied by the pinned R runtime. Non-numerical import dependencies are installed from official CRAN and recorded with sessionInfo; they are not asserted to match the author environment. GPArotation is imported by psych but the declared lowercase varimax path calls stats::varimax.
reference_environment.r_parity_status: Not run locally: Rscript is unavailable. No R result fixture is fabricated.

updates: Canonicalized unrotated eigenvector signs for portable display; largest absolute component positive, deterministic tie handling.
Python and reference R explicitly use Kaiser normalization and relative eps=1e-12; last decimals differ from the earlier isolated prototype.
Baseline and reverse-p03 outputs are independently reproducible; both20×10 inputs are synthetic.

verification_policy: R comparison requires actual exports, fixed versions/hashes and predeclared tolerances in full CI. An executable R file alone is not evidence of a completed comparison.
